text: Hello, and welcome back to another week
of Samba Iris. You join us in the GT3s
this time for a hot lap of Spa Grand
Prix pits edition. If you do want a more
detailed breakdown, we did do them for
the Porsche and the Ferrari, but seeing
as it's sort of 99.9% the same, we're
just doing hot laps for the others. If
you want to race the exact setup being
driven in this guide, you can go to our
page. All links to both in the
description. Any question, let me know
in the comments, but please note the
track conditions and track temps are
